points.text: Iterative LLM-PDDL generation with feedback not new; closest prior works uncited and undifferentiated.
'Causal learning' is effect extraction and frequency counting, not causal discovery.
Learned relations not evaluated for accuracy or compared to action-model learners.
Classic IPC domains likely in GPT-4 training data; contamination not discussed.
Missing comparisons to LLM domain generators, NL2Plan, generalized planning, PlanBench setup.
'New domains' first claim made without literature search.
Guaranteed optimality overclaimed; LAMA is satisficing and PDDL may be wrong.
Promised optimality rate never reported.
Garbled and misattributed citations.
Trust and critical-deployment claims unsupported; no simulator or failure-mode analysis.
Assumes deterministic, fully specified domains; no partial observability or noise.
Source of execution traces for learning unspecified; learning loop may not be exercised.
Runtime exceeds reactive planning budgets.
LLM validator consensus not independent; unclear if symbolic plan validator used.
Missing connections to formal verification, runtime monitoring, model-based diagnosis.
Contribution not isolated; 13-component bundle with grouped ablation.
Related work is a list without positioning.
Unnumbered headings, undefined table symbols, competition link as dataset.
Method equations fragmentary; method cannot be reconstructed.
GNN training data and loss unspecified.
Promotional claims exceed six-domain evaluation.
Figure 2 example plan is invalid in single-hand Blocksworld.
Venue fit: AAAI template, no representation-learning content.
'Significantly outperforming' LLM+P contradicted by p = 0.078.
Domain-level one-sided Wilcoxon over n=6 inadequate; 'Confidence' column invalid.
Baselines recreated without matched budget; no LLM+P with feedback/retry control.
Table 1 symbols P- and † undefined.
Protocol unstated: instance counts, sizes, validity check, runs, prompts, model version.
No train/test separation or memory-state protocol for learning components.
No learning-curve or memory-reset evidence for 'gets smarter over time'.
Ablation and text numbers inconsistent with Table 1 (82.1 vs 85.8; 67 vs 80).
'Symbolic core' includes LLM validators; neural/symbolic split confounded.
Components ablated in groups; no single-feature rows.
'Classical Baseline' never defined.
Feature-count correlation confounds identity and count.
Lower overhead than ToT claimed without cost data.
Protocol so under-specified that experiments cannot test central claims.
No equal-budget baseline or memory-reset controls.
Significance claim vs p = 0.078.
Figure 2 plan not executable.
Guaranteed optimality overclaim; optimality rate not reported.
Efficiency vs ToT asserted without measurements.
Table 2 vs Table 1 and storage numbers inconsistent.
IPC domains possibly in pre-training; no contamination analysis or held-out domain.
'Causal' relations are frequency-weighted action effects.
Table 1 symbols undefined.
Garbled author names and citation errors.
Feature-count argument confounds identity and count.
Missing comparison with PSALM on same IPC domains.
Omits relevant feedback-guided planning and world-model works (e.g., Guan et al.).
Tables oversized and hard to read.
Evaluation only with GPT-4; smaller or open models untested.
Handling of partial or noisy feedback unclear.
Citation command misuse and inconsistent reference style.
Overfull hboxes in tables.
Method section written in unorthodox LLM-like style with little design justification.
Task, input and output not formalized.
Confidence components, memories and causal relation types undefined.
How confidence weights were determined is unexplained.
Task decomposition procedure not explained.
Decomposition only works for serially decomposable, easy domains.
Apparently LLM-produced paper makes table numbers and empirical results untrustworthy.
How PDDL refinement is performed is not explained.
Related work does not distinguish approach from existing methods.
Theoretical foundation lacks analysis justifying iterative method.
Formatting issues: table spacing, quotation marks, inline example.
Only GPT-4 evaluated; generality unclear.

P.summary: Novelty vs uncited iterative LLM-PDDL feedback work.
Deployment/trust claims and promotional tone unsupported.
Runtime too slow for reactive use.
Inconsistent numbers across tables and text.
